accessibility.data_testid_policy: All key buttons, toggles, sections, inputs, and links MUST have role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the public sales page at path '/' in frontend React application.
Ensure unauthenticated visitors at '/' see this rich marketing page with Sign In and Get Started buttons pointing to '/login'.
Maintain complete EN/FR bilingual toggle state using the existing i18n system or local state so French visitors get a full native experience.
Reuse the exact purple diagonal background gradient 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2E1B6A 0%, #3B1F80 55%, #4B1D93 100%)' for high-impact hero/banner elements.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes as specified in the test_id fields.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_slop: Do not build a generic boring centered white card landing page. Use deep purple gradients, glassmorphism, glowing green accents, bento grids, and high-density financial metrics.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header MUST have blur background 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#120B2E]/80 border-b border-white/10' so text is always readable over scrolled content.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_ids: Every button, link, toggle, input, card, and section MUST include data-testid.
